scripts.build:wasm: bun run build:backend && RUSTC_WRAPPER= wasm-pack build --locked --dev --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name ryugu_wasm && node src/tools/normalize_frontend_wasm.mjs
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run styles && RUSTC_WRAPPER= wasm-pack build --locked --release --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name ryugu_wasm && node src/tools/normalize_frontend_wasm.mjs
scripts.dev: bun run styles && bun run build:wasm && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun run src/server.ts
